rules: Map of existing features. One-way mirror to the GitHub Project as Kind=Map cards. Edited by the lead.

items.title: First-run setup
items.what: Asks for name, monthly budget, savings (euro or %) and usual income once, so the app has a plan from day one.

items.title: Edit the plan
items.what: Changes name, budget, savings and usual income later; the current month plan is refreshed.

items.title: Add an expense
items.what: Records an expense with category and optional foreign currency plus the euro amount charged by the bank.

items.title: Expense templates
items.what: Saves a frequent expense as a template and adds it again with one tap.
items.where_in_app: Home > Templates (saved from Add expense > Save as template)

items.title: Add income or refund
items.what: Records extra income, and marks an expense as a refund so it lowers spending.
items.where_in_app: Home > Add income; Month > open entry > Refund

items.title: Left to spend
items.what: Shows what is left to spend this month, latest entries and the nearest savings goal.
items.notes: Home screen is src/views/add.js (tab "add" in app.js).

items.title: Month list and search
items.what: Lists the month entries and searches all history by text, category, type, amount and dates.

items.title: Charts
items.what: Shows Spending, Income, Trends (12 months) and Year totals with a yearly CSV.

items.title: Month CSV export
items.what: Downloads the month as CSV in Europe (;) or Standard (,) format.
items.where_in_app: Settings > Backup & export > Europe CSV / Standard CSV

items.title: Import a bank statement
items.what: Reads CSV, pasted text, .xlsx, camt XML or FiDAViSTA XML on the device and turns rows into entries.
items.where_in_app: Settings > Import > Import a bank statement

items.title: Duplicates and rules
items.what: Flags rows already in the app, lets the owner pick a kind per row and remember it as a rule.
items.where_in_app: Settings > Import > Import a bank statement (review step); Settings > Rules

items.title: Plan choice for past months
items.what: Asks once, for a past month without a plan, to use the current budget or record only actual spending.
items.where_in_app: Settings > Import > Import a bank statement (plan question)

items.title: Undo an import
items.what: Removes exactly one import entries and keeps rules and manual entries.

items.title: Savings goals
items.what: Creates goals with a target and optional deadline; edit, close or delete them.
items.where_in_app: Settings > Goals; nearest goal on Home

items.title: Add money to a goal
items.what: Adds money to a goal; it is recorded as a Savings expense and progress updates.
items.where_in_app: Home > goal card > Add money; Settings > Goals > Add money

items.title: JSON backup
items.what: Exports a full JSON backup and restores it on this or another device after confirmation.
items.where_in_app: Settings > Backup & export > Export backup / Import backup

items.title: Backup reminder
items.what: Reminds the owner after 14 days without a backup and more strongly after 30; can be snoozed.

items.title: Update bar and data conversion
items.what: Shows an Update bar when a new version is ready; converts data once and keeps the old copy.
items.where_in_app: Update bar at top; Settings > Backup & export > Download pre-update copy

items.title: Release via branch v1
items.what: Ships a new version by raising the version pair and publishing the v1 branch.
items.where_in_app: Not in the app: repository release step (see README Development)
items.notes: Operator step, no UI. The version pair is checked by a test.
